title: helicteres angustifolia var. lanceolata
intro: Helicteres angustifolia var. lanceolata, commonly known as the lance-leaved helicteres, is a plant species that belongs to the Helicteres genus and is widely distributed in tropical regions. The lance-leaved helicteres has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Studies suggest that the therapeutic actions of this plant may be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Helicteres angustifolia var. lanceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
